# Paul Irving

## Overview

- **Age:** Around 10 to 11 years old
- **Gender:** Male
- **Status:** Alive
- **Origin:** Boston, Massachusetts
- **Role:** Student

## Appearance

Paul is a remarkably handsome young boy with a refined, sensitive face. He has dark, glowing eyes and soft, chestnut-brown curls. His expressive countenance mirrors his vivid imagination and emotional nature.

## Personality

Paul is a highly imaginative, poetic, and sensitive child. He feels a deep kinship with nature, often populating the shore and woods with ideal friends and magical stories. Highly intelligent and well-mannered, he possesses a tender heart and deep devotion to those he loves. His vivid inner life makes him a soulmate to Anne Shirley, who sees much of her younger self in him.

## Traits

- Imaginative
- Poetic
- Sensitive
- Affectionate
- Polite

## Abilities

- Storytelling and creative writing
- Academic excellence

## Goals

- To be reunited with his father, Stephen Irving
- To write beautiful stories and honor his mother's memory

## History

Paul Irving arrives in Avonlea to live with his paternal grandmother, Mrs. Irving, after spending his earlier childhood in Boston following his mother's death. When Anne Shirley takes her position as the Avonlea schoolteacher, she instantly recognizes Paul as a kindred spirit due to his vivid imagination and love of beauty. Paul forms a strong bond with Anne, sharing his secret imaginary friends—such as the Rock People and his double, 'Good Paul'—and confiding his deepest feelings to her. During his time in Avonlea, he longs for his father, Stephen Irving, who works away in the United States. Anne later facilitates the reunion of Stephen Irving and his old love, Lavender Lewis; as a result, Stephen marries Miss Lavender, giving Paul a beloved new mother and a happy family life.

## Background by volume

- Born in Boston to Stephen Irving and his deceased mother
- Sent to live with his grandmother, Mrs. Irving, in Avonlea
